entities.name: Radelgar of Benevento
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Radelgar was the prince of Benevento from 851 until 854. He was the son of Radelchis I and Caretrude. He succeeded his father and married a Beneventa noblewoman named Tasselgarda.
